references.text: The prophecy that all the warriors who left Egypt would die in the wilderness, fulfilled in Joshua 5:4
Confirms that none of those counted in the wilderness of Sinai remained, except Caleb and Joshua
Describes the departure from Egypt with all the men who later died in the wilderness
God's judgment on the generation that left Egypt—they would not see the promised land
Summarizes that the entire warrior generation died out in the wilderness as the Lord had sworn
Repeats that the men who left Egypt would not see the land, and that the Lord made them wander in the wilderness for forty years
The first circumcision of Moses' son, showing the significance of circumcision for the covenant people
